extraction_notes: The job identity is preserved exactly: frozen campaign order 937, LCSC C5246424, manufacturer TECH PUBLIC, family mosfet, and MPN FDN360P.
The canonical PDF identifies a single P-channel PowerTrench MOSFET and publishes no datasheet revision; revision is recorded as not stated in PDF.
P-channel voltage and current numeric values are stored as magnitudes; the signed source values and test conditions are retained in condition strings.
The VGS(th) table publishes minimum -1.0 V and maximum -3.0 V with no typical value; the separate VSD row publishes a maximum -1.2 V.
The canonical PDF contains no plotted characteristic curves; no curve points were invented or inferred.
omission_reason: The canonical PDF contains no plotted characteristic curves; it provides summary, ratings, electrical-characteristics tables, and package information only.
